title: Brazilian Zesty Fritters
description: A delicious Brazilian-inspired appetizer or snack made with zesty fritters.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, batter mix, zesty fritter mix, egg, milk, and salt.
3. Mix the ingredients until a smooth batter forms.
4. If using, add the tod and cheese to the batter and mix well.
5. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the hot oil.
6. Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
8. Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
